# Cellular_vs_LEO_Satellite_Handoff

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The comparative analysis and prediction of connectivity handoffs between terrestrial cellular networks and low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite links (e.g., Starlink) for UAVs in flight. Informs hybrid topology routing decisions in TCC, where UAVs must switch between heterogeneous link types based on real-time 3D position and coverage.
